description: Defines interfaces and factory functions for Diffie-Hellman key exchange mechanisms, including asynchronous and synchronous variants, within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: AsynchronousKeyExchange
classes.description: Interface for asynchronous Diffie-Hellman key exchange, supporting private key storage and external key exchange services.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Base class for receiving results of asynchronous key exchange operations.

classes.name: SynchronousKeyExchange
classes.description: Interface for synchronous Diffie-Hellman key exchange, extending the asynchronous interface.

methods.name: CalculateSharedKeyAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous calculation of shared key with a peer public value.

methods.name: CalculateSharedKeySync
methods.description: Performs synchronous calculation of shared key with a peer public value.

methods.name: public_value
methods.description: Returns the local public key for key exchange.
